mapper.select: SELECT wm.member_id memberId, md.name, wm.role, md.profile profilePhoto, md.email, wm.workspace_id workId FROM workspace_members wm JOIN members m ON m.member_id = wm.member_id JOIN member_details md ON m.member_id = md.member_id WHERE wm.workspace_id = #{workId} AND wm.status = 0 AND m.status = 0 ORDER BY role DESC, name ASC

SELECT wm.member_id memberId, p.subject projectNames FROM workspace_members wm JOIN project_members pm ON wm.workspace_member_id = pm.workspace_member_id JOIN projects p ON pm.project_id = p.project_id WHERE wm.workspace_id = #{workId} AND wm.status = 0 AND pm.status = 0 AND pm."LEFT" IS NULL AND p.deleted IS NULL ORDER BY wm.member_id, p.subject
